title: observability: token-level cost/latency dashboard + alert tuning and KV metrics enhancements
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Adds a token-level cost and latency dashboard with KV-cache-aware breakdowns, improves tracing labels for batch and cache-hit attribution, and tunes several production alerts to reduce noisy paging. Motivation: customers are asking for deeper per-token visibility to validate optimizations (quantization, batching, caching) and to better correlate cost with latency regressions. This PR bundles the dashboard panels, new metric exports, tracing tag standardization, and adjusted alert thresholds.

What I changed: high-level: - Exported token_cost_per_request and token_latency_p50/p95/p99 as derived metrics in the metrics exporter. Metrics include label sets: model_name, deployment_mode (hosted/dedicated/private), kv_hit (true/false), batch_size_bucket. - Added tracing attributes: scaled_batch_size, kv_hit, kernel_variant so traces can be filtered to understand end-to-end token latency contributors. - New Grafana dashboard: Observability / Token-level Cost & Latency (panels: token cost by model & kv_hit, latency distribution by batch size, heatmap of cost vs p99 latency, lane showing cache hit rate vs cost). - Alert tuning: adjusted alert thresholds and added composite alerts to avoid noisy incidents. Examples: - token_cost_spike alert now requires sustained delta > 40% for 5m and correlated p99 latency > 200ms before paging. - kv_cache_drop alert triggers only if kv_hit rate drops > 20% for 3m and request rate > 100rps. - Added runbook links and playbook notes to the alert definitions.

Testing and rollout: - Unit tests for metrics exporter + integration tests validating label presence in traces. - E2E smoke: deployed to staging for 48h using replayed production traffic from benchmark-lab. Verified dashboard panels and that alerts fire under synthetic regressions. - Gradual rollout: merged to main - dashboards deployed to grafana/staging, will be promoted to prod with a config flip on 2026-03-02.

Notes: The description below contains a checklist and references to related work.

review_comments: Marcus Chen: Nice consolidation. Two asks: 1) can we include model_size label (small/med/large) to aid cross-model comparisons? 2) confirm cardinality of batch_size_bucket to avoid high metric cardinality.
Aisha Patel (author): Added model_size label and bucketed batch_size into 6 coarse buckets (1,2-4,5-8,9-16,17-32,33+). Verified high-cardinality regression tests pass.
Ravi Srinivasan: Alert gating improvement looks good. Suggest adding a suppression window for deploy-related noise (10m) — otherwise we'll get pages during large rollouts.
Aisha Patel (author): Added suppression on token_cost_spike for known deploy label; documented in runbook.
merge_summary: Merged by squash on 2026-03-01 after approvals from Marcus Chen and Ravi Srinivasan. No conflicts. Rollout notes added; dashboards staged for production promotion.
release_notes: Observability: Added token-level Cost & Latency dashboard with KV-cache-aware breakdowns, improved tracing attributes for batch/cache attribution, and tuned token-related alerts to reduce noise. Recommended: monitor composite alerts for first 72h post-rollout.
testing_notes: Staging replayed traffic for 48h. Synthetic regression tests simulated cache-eviction and batch-size changes to validate alert triggers. Integration tests ensure metric labels are emitted for hosted/dedicated/private modes.
notes_for_sre: SRE: watch token_cost_spike and kv_cache_drop composite alerts. If false positives observed, increase sustained window to 10m and verify suppression label for deploy. Contact author (Aisha) for quick rollback of dashboard changes.
backwards_compatibility: no-op for metrics ingestion; added labels are optional and default to 'unknown' when not present.
